issue-repair.title: Fix & verification
issue-repair.intro: Prepare a repair from this issue, freeze its regression scope, then close it only with current independent test evidence and human acceptance.
issue-repair.invalid_read: The response does not match this issue or its repair basis. Keep the original operation and refresh.
issue-repair.access_changed: Current access changed. Protected repair details have been cleared.
issue-repair.refresh_failed: The change was saved, but its view could not refresh. Refresh the existing record rather than creating it again.
issue-repair.draft_open: Finish or cancel the repair draft before folding this panel.
issue-repair.current_version: Actions below use the current issue version {{version}}.
issue-repair.no_regression: No regression scope is bound yet.
issue-repair.ready: The server reports the current closure conditions are met. They will be checked again when you confirm.
issue-repair.readiness_boundary: Closing requires current formal acceptance of the repair task and passing independent evidence for every selected regression case. Missing or stale evidence remains unresolved.
issue-repair.no_repair: No repair task has been prepared for this cycle.
issue-repair.action.reopen: Reopen with a new repair cycle
issue-repair.prepare_hint: This links the issue’s requirement, creating a draft if needed, and creates a new ordinary repair task atomically. It does not dispatch execution or approve delivery. Assign the task in the existing task workspace.
issue-repair.criteria_hint: One verifiable criterion per line. Provide at least one.
issue-repair.prepare_required: Complete the title and acceptance criteria within the field limits.
issue-repair.bind_hint: Choose the repair task’s current published plan and explicit cases. For a test-origin issue, include the original case key and exact report selector. The server verifies this relationship.
issue-repair.no_plan: No plan is available for this repair task. Create and publish one in Test plans first.
issue-repair.close_hint: The closure keeps the exact run, source commits, regression scope and formal review. Historical failures remain recorded.
issue-repair.close_ack: I have reviewed this repair and its independent regression evidence and confirm closing the issue on this fixed basis.
issue-repair.reopen_hint: Reopening preserves this closure and its evidence, then starts a new repair cycle. Previous evidence does not automatically close the new cycle.
issue-repair.history_limited: Only part of the history is shown here. Earlier records remain preserved.
issue-repair.editing_hint: Issue status is managed by the repair and verification workflow. This editor only changes the issue’s descriptive fields.
issue-repair.blocker.repair_not_prepared: Prepare a repair task before closing this issue.
issue-repair.blocker.issue_closed: This issue is already closed. Reopen it explicitly before another repair.
issue-repair.blocker.regression_not_boun: Bind a published regression plan and its selected cases.
issue-repair.blocker.repair_task_not_acc: The repair task has not received current formal acceptance.
issue-repair.blocker.repair_run_changed: No matching current run. Review or arrange execution.
issue-repair.blocker.repair_evidence_sta: Repair evidence no longer matches the current basis.
issue-repair.blocker.regression_plan_cha: The regression plan changed or its published basis is no longer current.
issue-repair.blocker.regression_case_fai: At least one selected regression case lacks passing current evidence.
issue-repair.blocker.original_case_requi: Include the original failed case and its exact report selector.
issue-repair.blocker.formal_review_missi: The current repair run has no matching formal acceptance review.
issue-repair.package_bind_hint: Choose the repair task’s published plan and regression cases. Closing also requires independent package verification for the original application scope.
issue-repair.blocker.package_regression_: Run an independent package check for the repair and verify the sealed artifact before closing.
The regression does not match the original package check. Verify the test profile, application, source scope, and Git target.
